entries.speaker: Igor
entries.en: ...It would seem as though you have[n]been killed.

entries.speaker: Igor
entries.en: Why did you have to die?

entries.speaker: Igor
entries.en: It seems you forgot an important fact[n]while your consciousness was hazy.
entries.uk: Схоже, ти забув важливий факт,[n]поки твоя свідомість була затуманена.

entries.speaker: Igor
entries.en: Indeed... Your "death" was a necessity[n]for your escape from certain doom.
entries.uk: Саме так... Твоя «смерть» була необхідна,[n]щоб уникнути неминучої загибелі.

entries.speaker: Igor
entries.en: How might you be capable of executing[n]such a feat?

entries.speaker: Igor
entries.en: Well then, let us rouse the memories[n]which are missing...
